title: Silk #16 Marvel 2017 Clone Conspiracy Tie-In Helen Chen Cover Robbie Thompson
conditionDescription: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Silk #16 (2017), Marvel Comics - A Clone Conspiracy tie-in at New U. Written by Robbie Thompson, art by Irene Strychalski, cover by Helen Chen. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Party City Captain America 75th anniversary ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
